description: This source file defines a MainActivity class, which acts as a compatibility shim that forwards the app's launch to a real MainActivity located in a different package, ensuring legacy references remain functional without relying on inheritance.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: A subclass of Activity that forwards the intent to the real main activity and then finishes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the Activity's onCreate method to start the real MainActivity and close this one.
